A retrieval-augmented chatbot over my professional profile. Answers come from a
curated knowledge base, not from the model's memory — a query classifier routes
each question to one of three collections (career, my own research, or the
related literature) before retrieval. Tick "Show retrieved chunks" to see the
passages it read and which route it took. Runs on Google Cloud Run and scales
to zero when idle, so the first load after a quiet period takes up to a minute.
